package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var (
	// ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound is returned when a student has no teacher record.
	ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound = errors.New("personal teacher not found")
	// ErrVersionConflict is returned when an optimistic update uses a stale version.
	ErrVersionConflict = errors.New("personal teacher version conflict")
)

const (
	DefaultTeacherProfileID = "default"
	DefaultLanguage         = "ru"
	DefaultCommunication    = "adaptive"
	DefaultPedagogyProfile  = "adaptive"
	DefaultHintPolicy       = "progressive"
	DefaultInterventionMode = "balanced"
)

// PersonalTeacher is the persistent logical teacher assigned to one student.
// It deliberately contains no student mastery, path, attempts, or dialog history.
type PersonalTeacher struct {
	ID                 string    `json:"id"`
	StudentID          string    `json:"student_id"`
	TeacherProfileID   string    `json:"teacher_profile_id"`
	Language           string    `json:"language"`
	CommunicationStyle string    `json:"communication_style"`
	PedagogyProfile    string    `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	HintPolicy         string    `json:"hint_policy"`
	InterventionMode   string    `json:"intervention_mode"`
	Version            int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt          time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// PersonalTeacherSettings contains user-configurable teacher behavior.
type PersonalTeacherSettings struct {
	TeacherProfileID   string `json:"teacher_profile_id"`
	Language           string `json:"language"`
	CommunicationStyle string `json:"communication_style"`
	PedagogyProfile    string `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	HintPolicy         string `json:"hint_policy"`
	InterventionMode   string `json:"intervention_mode"`
}

// DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings returns deterministic settings for new students.
func DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings() PersonalTeacherSettings {
	return PersonalTeacherSettings{
		TeacherProfileID:   DefaultTeacherProfileID,
		Language:           DefaultLanguage,
		CommunicationStyle: DefaultCommunication,
		PedagogyProfile:    DefaultPedagogyProfile,
		HintPolicy:         DefaultHintPolicy,
		InterventionMode:   DefaultInterventionMode,
	}
}

// NewPersonalTeacher creates a valid logical teacher for one student.
func NewPersonalTeacher(id, studentID string, settings PersonalTeacherSettings, now time.Time) (PersonalTeacher, error) {
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	settings = normalizeSettings(settings)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil || studentID == "" || !validSettings(settings) {
		return PersonalTeacher{}, errors.New("invalid personal teacher")
	}
	now = now.UTC()
	return PersonalTeacher{
		ID:                 id,
		StudentID:          studentID,
		TeacherProfileID:   settings.TeacherProfileID,
		Language:           settings.Language,
		CommunicationStyle: settings.CommunicationStyle,
		PedagogyProfile:    settings.PedagogyProfile,
		HintPolicy:         settings.HintPolicy,
		InterventionMode:   settings.InterventionMode,
		Version:            1,
		CreatedAt:          now,
		UpdatedAt:          now,
	}, nil
}

// Settings returns the configurable portion of the teacher.
func (teacher PersonalTeacher) Settings() PersonalTeacherSettings {
	return PersonalTeacherSettings{
		TeacherProfileID:   teacher.TeacherProfileID,
		Language:           teacher.Language,
		CommunicationStyle: teacher.CommunicationStyle,
		PedagogyProfile:    teacher.PedagogyProfile,
		HintPolicy:         teacher.HintPolicy,
		InterventionMode:   teacher.InterventionMode,
	}
}

// UpdateSettings applies a versioned settings update.
func (teacher *PersonalTeacher) UpdateSettings(settings PersonalTeacherSettings, expectedVersion int64, now time.Time) error {
	if teacher == nil || expectedVersion <= 0 || teacher.Version != expectedVersion {
		return ErrVersionConflict
	}
	settings = normalizeSettings(settings)
	if !validSettings(settings) {
		return errors.New("invalid personal teacher settings")
	}
	teacher.TeacherProfileID = settings.TeacherProfileID
	teacher.Language = settings.Language
	teacher.CommunicationStyle = settings.CommunicationStyle
	teacher.PedagogyProfile = settings.PedagogyProfile
	teacher.HintPolicy = settings.HintPolicy
	teacher.InterventionMode = settings.InterventionMode
	teacher.Version++
	teacher.UpdatedAt = now.UTC()
	return nil
}

func normalizeSettings(settings PersonalTeacherSettings) PersonalTeacherSettings {
	settings.TeacherProfileID = strings.TrimSpace(settings.TeacherProfileID)
	settings.Language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.Language))
	settings.CommunicationStyle = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.CommunicationStyle))
	settings.PedagogyProfile = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.PedagogyProfile))
	settings.HintPolicy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.HintPolicy))
	settings.InterventionMode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(settings.InterventionMode))
	return settings
}

func validSettings(settings PersonalTeacherSettings) bool {
	return validValue(settings.TeacherProfileID, 128) &&
		validValue(settings.Language, 35) &&
		validValue(settings.CommunicationStyle, 64) &&
		validValue(settings.PedagogyProfile, 64) &&
		validValue(settings.HintPolicy, 64) &&
		validValue(settings.InterventionMode, 64)
}

func validValue(value string, maximum int) bool {
	return value != "" && len(value) <= maximum
}
